subject: dsa
title: Task Scheduler
summary: With a cooldown of n between identical tasks, greedily fill windows of n+1 slots with the most frequent tasks. A max-heap of remaining counts always hands you the busiest tasks first, inserting idle slots only when nothing is ready.
problem: Schedule tasks with a cooldown of n = 2 between identical tasks, and find the least total time. Use a max-heap of remaining counts and fill each window of n+1 = 3 slots with the most frequent tasks.

steps.caption: A cooldown of n = 2 means windows of 3 slots. Use a max-heap of counts, with A = 3 and B = 3.
A window has 3 slots. Take the two highest counts, A then B, then idle. The slots so far are A B idle, and the counts drop to 2 and 2.
Repeat the window: A B idle drops the counts to 1 and 1, then A B fills the last window with no idle.
Done. The schedule is A B idle A B idle A B, so the total time is 8 units.
